scripts.type-check: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @drip/shared-types type-check && pnpm --filter web type-check && pnpm --filter mobile type-check
scripts.lint: eslint scripts eslint.config.mjs && pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter mobile lint && pnpm lint:api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api --locked --extra dev ruff check --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src apps/api/tests apps/api/migrations scripts
scripts.type-check:api: uv run --project apps/api --locked --extra dev mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/api --locked --extra dev pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.test:integration: uv run --project apps/api --locked --extra dev pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests -m integration
scripts.check:mobile: pnpm --filter mobile exec expo install --check && pnpm --filter mobile exec expo-doctor
scripts.verify:static: uv run --project apps/api --locked --extra dev python scripts/verify_foundation.py
